mapper.select: SELECT FROM growth_roadmaps WHERE id = #{roadmapId} FOR UPDATE
INSERT INTO growth_roadmaps (streamer_id, prompt_version) VALUES (#{streamerId}, #{promptVersion}) ON CONFLICT (streamer_id) DO UPDATE SET prompt_version = growth_roadmaps.prompt_version RETURNING id
SELECT count(*) FROM reports r JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL')
SELECT s.streamer_id FROM reports r JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE r.id = #{reportId} AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL')
SELECT FROM growth_roadmap_generations WHERE id = #{generationId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM growth_roadmap_generations WHERE roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} AND status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING') ORDER BY requested_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_roadmap_generations SET status = 'PROCESSING', started_at = #{startedAt}, error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{generationId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE growth_roadmap_generations SET status = 'COMPLETED', input_fingerprint = #{fingerprint}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, error_code = NULL WHERE id = #{generationId} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE growth_roadmaps SET status = 'PENDING', quality = #{quality}, source_report_id = #{sourceReportId}, prompt_version = #{promptVersion}, stale = current_generation_id IS NOT NULL, generation_error = NULL WHERE id = #{roadmapId}
UPDATE growth_roadmaps SET status = 'WAITING_FOR_DATA', prompt_version = #{promptVersion}, stale = current_generation_id IS NOT NULL WHERE id = #{roadmapId}
UPDATE growth_roadmaps SET stale = true WHERE id = #{roadmapId}
UPDATE growth_roadmaps SET status = 'PROCESSING' WHERE id = #{roadmapId}

UPDATE growth_roadmaps SET status = 'READY', quality = #{quality}, current_generation_id = #{generationId}, source_report_id = #{sourceReportId}, prompt_version = #{promptVersion}, stale = false, generated_at = #{generatedAt}, generation_error = NULL WHERE id = #{roadmapId}
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.roadmap_id, s.generation_id, s.display_order, s.metric_type, s.target_value, s.unit, s.period_start, s.period_end, s.title, s.rationale, s.status, s.accepted_goal_id, s.accepted_at, s.dismissed_at FROM growth_goal_suggestions s JOIN growth_roadmaps r ON r.id = s.roadmap_id WHERE s.roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} AND s.generation_id = r.current_generation_id ORDER BY s.display_order, s.id

SELECT s.id, s.roadmap_id, s.generation_id, s.display_order, s.metric_type, s.target_value, s.unit, s.period_start, s.period_end, s.title, s.rationale, s.status, s.accepted_goal_id, s.accepted_at, s.dismissed_at FROM growth_goal_suggestions s JOIN growth_roadmaps r ON r.id = s.roadmap_id WHERE s.id = #{suggestionId} AND r.streamer_id = #{streamerId} FOR UPDATE OF s
mapper.update: UPDATE growth_goal_suggestions SET status = 'SUPERSEDED' WHERE roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} AND status = 'SUGGESTED'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO growth_suggestion_actions ( suggestion_id, display_order, title, content ) VALUES
(#{suggestionId}, #{index} + 1, #{action.title}, #{action.content})

INSERT INTO growth_actions ( growth_goal_id, source_suggestion_id, title, content ) SELECT #{goalId}, suggestion_id, title, content FROM growth_suggestion_actions WHERE suggestion_id = #{suggestionId} ORDER BY display_order
mapper.select: WITH buckets AS ( SELECT day::date AS period_start, (day::date + 6) AS period_end FROM generate_series( cast(#{from} as date)::timestamp, cast(#{to} as date)::timestamp, interval '7 days' ) day ), eligible AS ( SELECT s.started_at, s.ended_at, r.avg_viewers, r.total_chat FROM broadcast_sessions s JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') AND (s.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} ) SELECT b.period_start, b.period_end, round(avg(e.avg_viewers))::int AS avg_viewers, coalesce(sum(e.total_chat), 0)::bigint AS total_chat, round(coalesce(sum(extract(epoch FROM (e.ended_at - e.started_at))), 0) / 60.0)::bigint AS broadcast_minutes, round((count(e.started_at)::numeric), 2) AS broadcasts_per_week FROM buckets b LEFT JOIN eligible e ON (e.started_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')::date BETWEEN b.period_start AND b.period_end GROUP BY b.period_start, b.period_end ORDER BY b.period_start

SELECT r.id AS report_id, s.id AS session_id, s.title, coalesce(s.category, '') AS category, s.ended_at, r.status, r.avg_viewers, r.peak_viewers, coalesce(r.total_chat, 0)::bigint AS total_chat, coalesce(r.analyzed_chat, 0)::bigint AS analyzed_chat, round(extract(epoch FROM (s.ended_at - s.started_at)) / 60.0)::bigint AS broadcast_minutes, coalesce(r.summary, '') AS summary, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(i.title || ': ' || i.content, E'
' ORDER BY i.id) FROM (SELECT * FROM report_insights WHERE report_id = r.id ORDER BY id LIMIT 3) i), '') AS insights, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(t.trigger_type || ': ' || coalesce(t.narrative, ''), E'
' ORDER BY t.peak_z DESC, t.id) FROM (SELECT * FROM triggers WHERE session_id = s.id ORDER BY peak_z DESC, id LIMIT 5) t), '') AS triggers, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(h.start_ms || '-' || h.end_ms, ', ' ORDER BY h.start_ms, h.id) FROM (SELECT * FROM highlights WHERE report_id = r.id ORDER BY start_ms, id LIMIT 5) h), '') AS highlights, concat('analyzed=', coalesce(r.analyzed_chat, 0), ', joy=', coalesce(r.joy_count, 0), ', excitement=', coalesce(r.excitement_count, 0), ', support=', coalesce(r.support_count, 0), ', neutral=', coalesce(r.neutral_count, 0)) AS emotion_summary, coalesce((SELECT string_agg(x.risk_category || ':' || x.risk_level || '=' || x.cnt, ', ' ORDER BY x.risk_category, x.risk_level) FROM (SELECT risk_category, risk_level, count(*) cnt FROM risk_events WHERE session_id = s.id GROUP BY risk_category, risk_level) x), '') AS risk_summary, coalesce(( SELECT string_agg( concat(pa.platform, ':avg=', coalesce(rpm.avg_viewers::text, 'unknown'), ',peak=', coalesce(rpm.peak_viewers::text, 'unknown'), ',chat=', rpm.total_chat, ',minutes=', round(rpm.broadcast_seconds / 60.0), ',coverage=', coalesce(rpm.viewer_coverage::text, 'unsupported'), ',quality=', rpm.data_quality), E'
' ORDER BY pa.platform, rpm.platform_session_id ) FROM report_platform_metrics rpm JOIN broadcast_platform_sessions ps ON ps.id = rpm.platform_session_id JOIN platform_accounts pa ON pa.id = ps.platform_account_id WHERE rpm.report_id = r.id ), '') AS platform_breakdown, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM collection_gaps g WHERE g.session_id = s.id) AS collection_gap FROM reports r JOIN broadcast_sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') ORDER BY s.ended_at DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT count(s.id)::bigint AS broadcast_count, round((count(s.id)::numeric / (30.0 / 7.0)), 2) AS broadcasts_per_week, round(coalesce(sum(extract(epoch FROM (s.ended_at - s.started_at))), 0) / 60.0)::bigint AS total_broadcast_minutes, round(coalesce(avg(extract(epoch FROM (s.ended_at - s.started_at))), 0) / 60.0, 2) AS average_broadcast_minutes, round(avg(r.avg_viewers), 2) AS average_viewers, max(r.peak_viewers)::int AS peak_viewers, coalesce(sum(r.total_chat), 0)::bigint AS total_chat, round(coalesce(sum(r.total_chat), 0)::numeric / nullif(count(s.id), 0), 2) AS chats_per_broadcast, coalesce(string_agg(DISTINCT coalesce(s.category, '미분류'), ', '), '') AS category_distribution FROM broadcast_sessions s JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id WHERE s.streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') AND s.started_at >= #{from}

SELECT metric_type, target_value, 0::numeric AS current_value, 0::numeric AS progress_rate, status FROM growth_goals WHERE streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'ACHIEVED') ORDER BY period_end, id
SELECT max(completed_at) FROM growth_roadmap_generations WHERE roadmap_id = #{roadmapId} AND status = 'COMPLETED'
SELECT id, streamer_id, metric_type, target_value, unit, period_start, period_end, status, revision FROM growth_goals WHERE streamer_id = #{streamerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT s.streamer_id FROM broadcast_sessions s JOIN reports r ON r.session_id = s.id LEFT JOIN growth_roadmaps roadmap ON roadmap.streamer_id = s.streamer_id WHERE s.status = 'ENDED' AND r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PARTIAL') AND (roadmap.id IS NULL OR roadmap.prompt_version <> #{promptVersion}) ORDER BY s.streamer_id LIMIT #{limit}
